item.title: ‘Way Of The Warrior Kid’ Review: Chris Pratt’s Formulaic Coming-Of-Age Drama Is All Over The Place
item.description: If you haven’t read a book, are you in a suitable position to properly judge its film adaptation? The answer, of course, is to treat said adaptation on its own merits, but in the case of McG ’s shiny new Apple TV effort based on Jocko Willink ’s “ Way Of The Warrior Kid ,” it’s far too easy to see just another story riddled with unoriginality, with an overall tone that can’t seem to resist veering wildly off course more often than one might expect. item.title: Director David Leitch Confirms Attachment To 'Ocean's 14' With "Great Script," But Scheduling Remains An "Issue"
item.description: Back in January 2025, director David Leitch ("How to Rob A Bank") was reportedly in talks to helm " Ocean's 14 ," and there is pretty much confirmation from the man himself that he’s still attached to the heist sequel. item.title: ‘Mr. Irrelevant’ Trailer: David Corenswet Suits Up As John Tuggle In Jonathan Levine’s Underdog Sports Drama
item.description: There is a certain kind of sports movie title that almost dares you to underestimate it, and “ Mr. Irrelevant ” certainly qualifies. But Paramount Pictures and director Jonathan Levine are aiming for something warmer and more old-school with this inspirational football drama about John Tuggle , the final pick in the 1983 NFL Draft who became a beloved New York Giant. David Corenswet , coming off “ Superman ,” stars as Tuggle, alongside Isabel May as his love interest Katie and Michael Shannon as legendary Giants coach Bill Parcells .
